args.data:
Client Meeting Prep – Coordinator Note

Two workstreams have been delegated for the upcoming client meeting:

1. IR Analyst (ir-analyst): Earnings quality, valuation, and peer comparison analysis.
2. Portfolio Analyst (portfolio-analyst): Holdings review, risk exposure, and performance attribution analysis.

Both workstreams are assigned to the Bench Stark Enterprise backend. Deliverables from each analyst will be consolidated on this Delegation Board prior to the client meeting.
